How Modular Minifiers Work

Published January 15, 2024

A modular minifier splits its work into many small, focused transformations. Each transformation — or module — is responsible for exactly one kind of optimization.

Consider whitespace collapsing. It should not care about comments, attributes, or inline scripts. Those belong to other modules. This separation keeps every piece easy to reason about.

Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability.

Common Modules

  • Whitespace collapsing
  • Comment removal
  • Attribute normalization
  • Inline CSS & JS minification

You can read more in the official documentation.
